name: Probe
long_description:
Probe is building the agent-native research stack.

Our goal is simple: help AI/ML teams run better experiments, faster. We believe research will drive progress and everyone deserves to have their own personalized lab that iterates faster than ever before. 

Probe brings core research tools, shared context from past experiments, and visibility into each run together in one platform. Helping teams spend less time setting up infrastructure, supervising agents, catching teammates up and more time testing ideas.

Built for helping research labs experiment faster while keeping every researcher and agent aligned, and helping AI/ML teams setup a research capability without building a lab’s infrastructure first.

launches.title: Probe: The Agent-Native Research Stack
launches.body:
**Introducing Probe: The Agent-Native Research Stack.**

Our goal is simple: help AI/ML teams run better experiments faster.

<https://youtu.be/xOF8YLKm8nA> 

## The Problem

Teams are using agents for research, but their work is disordered. \
\
They lose hours verifying what their agents actually did, managing environments, sourcing and setting up compute, babysitting runs, wiring up evals, and re-explaining company context their agents should already know.\
\
On top of that, they have to spend critical time in meetings to share learnings across one another, and figuring out what to try next. 

## The Solution

So we rebuilt the research stack from the ground up for agent-driven research.

**How it works:** Probe brings three things together in one unified platform:

* **Agent-native research tools:** From experiment tracking, compute setup, and GPU monitoring, to paper discovery, dataset retrieval, and lit-review. Probe brings every research tool into one platform so agents can hit the ground running.
* **Shared context from past experiments:** give researchers and agents access to what team has already tried, so they can build on it instead of repeating the same failures and work. 
* **Visibility into ongoing research:** see what researchers and their agents are working on, track experiments, and steer research without waiting for another status meeting.

We help teams waste less compute on failed runs or tedious setup, and spend less time coordinating work.\
\
With Probe, researchers have the tools, context, and control to take ideas through rigorous experiments and faster iterations, **creating more research progress with the same compute.** 

## Our asks

* **If you’re a research lab,** **please reach out.** We would love to help you scale your research team without sacrificing speed.
* **If you’re an AI/ML team, please reach out.** We would love to help you stand up a research capability with the infrastructure of a frontier lab.

**See Probe for yourself: [https://www.useprobe.ai/](https://www.useprobe.ai/)**
